# Release details


## Caribou Biosciences to Participate in the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference


May 27, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.cariboubio.com/node/9516/pdf)


BERKELEY, Calif., May 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Caribou Biosciences](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iT4oonN9gK8H4QFVIYXSle161YMy9AxOszUVSJtguOCYrqDksb-J0CCzdwxv18KloBTKogvLZi1I5Ip-kkQEzqqSSvzDZ6Ho1EfULulXVTI=) , Inc. (Nasdaq: CRBU), a leading clinical-stage CRISPR genome-editing biopharmaceutical company, today announced Rachel Haurwitz, PhD, Caribou’s president and chief executive officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference on June 4, 2026, at 2:35pm ET in New York.


For more information and a link to the[webcast](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cHzgLB7Qw7g0gbTDMBoe6BBgT4pdBzpYPbqzD5wvNOitQY4T1wKTPzUgIw3vP-CPqLUMVVLi774MxrizX4N6PeliIpF140gP9GqYqZm7QLmEyP77jmJlPq6Y5jeAXmoVTSclIalgpDNCcIiiToTg41y9ZE3f0CLtL0mYyRKCr2s=) , visit the[Events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=adFxQJExgunz5evSH_D3Ou1WBI5sJeNXKYzFND-i5IFFsGdLq8HOZ3azuhAIy_6-NDnXrouIDkMdFCbJt_6mV3pjbxqMEMAT3mrgSD_ObEPZnpI5uaGoCGeQJ5Xbycjc) page on Caribou’s website. Webcasts will be available on the Caribou website for at least 30 days after the event.


**About Caribou Biosciences, Inc.**
Caribou is a clinical-stage CRISPR genome-editing biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing transformative therapies for patients with devastating diseases. Caribou’s chRDNA genome-editing technology enables superior precision to develop cell therapies that are armored to potentially improve activity against diseases. Caribou is focused on vispacabtagene regedleucel (vispa-cel) and CB-011 as off-the-shelf CAR-T cell therapies that have the potential to provide broad access and rapid treatment for patients with hematologic malignancies. Follow the company @CaribouBio and visit[www.cariboubio.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Gq6OGVT-X2BhnGaXIFgeSTFdqqiuKhRZ3GeA-4tSkhKlmkPSvUmELwzh7LmMR_a0ow41Z7MGbpxnHO3Zb8pATobUTFvOBuwnw2hs2N79pqE=) .
